basis: The chart's y-axis is labeled 'Reported clean-grid share (%)', and the bars are visually aligned with this scale. The 'Utility solar' bar ends at the 40% level, while the 'Offshore wind' bar extends higher, ending between the 65 and 70% ticks. The printed percentages (41.2% for Utility solar, 29.8% for Offshore wind) contradict the visual heights. Since the bar heights are visually aligned with the y-axis and the chart title and axis label imply the bars encode the reported share, bar geometry is the authoritative encoding. The tallest bar, 'Offshore wind', represents the largest contribution source.
option_label: Route Offshore wind to priority contribution review
